title: Male borrowers who mention specific geographic locations may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention a specific loan amount, such as PHP 10,000, may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who describe themselves as a 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention social contributions to their community may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention specific high-quality agricultural inputs, such as certified seeds and nutrient-rich fertilizers, may fund faster.
Female borrowers who use the phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention specific towns or village names may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention sending children to college may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention the loan is through NWTF may fund more slowly.
Pitches that mention specific institutional partners or field partners are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Mentioning family responsibilities or supporting family members predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
Mentioning a history of successful loan repayment or previous profits predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
